fold.why: the live pair this fold was written for: pk 598 and pk 1589, one concert, one night
an address with no trailing slash is unchanged
the slash before a query is a trailing slash, and the query survives untouched
a slash inside the query belongs to the query; performanceId is the identity of a night
the slash before a fragment is a trailing slash
structural, not trailing: folding it would name a different thing
a doubled trailing slash is refused outright rather than reduced by one, the conservative direction
an empty value is not an address and comes back unchanged
a value that is not an address at all comes back unchanged, so the fold is safe to apply to anything
case is NOT folded, in host or path: measured 2026-09-21 to join zero further pairs, and a path is case sensitive on some servers
the scheme is NOT folded to https: measured to join zero further pairs
